home.promise: Stop repeating the same English mistakes, in 10 minutes a day, explained in Arabic.
welcome.title: Welcome
welcome.chooseLang: Choose the language of the app
welcome.private: A private practice tool. No account, and no personal details are asked for.
welcome.device: Your progress stays on this device only.
welcome.notCert: This app does not give a certificate.
welcome.content: The lessons were written with the help of AI and have not yet been reviewed by a teacher.
placement.title: Placement test
placement.intro: 32 short questions, from easy to harder. It takes about 10 minutes. The test may stop early when the questions become too hard. That is normal.
placement.skip: Skip and start from the beginning (A1)
result.title: Your result
result.can.START_A1: You are at the start. You will learn simple words and short sentences about yourself and your day.
result.can.A1: You can understand and use simple sentences about yourself, your work and your daily life.
result.can.A2: You can talk about familiar topics, past events and plans, in short and clear sentences.
result.can.B1: You can write a clear message at work, describe a problem, and give your opinion with reasons.
result.can.B2: You can write clear and detailed texts on work topics, and explain a point of view.
result.mistakes: Mistake types in your wrong answers
result.noMistakes: No tagged mistake types were found in your wrong answers.
result.disclaimer: This is an estimate, not a certificate, and it has not been validated against an official test.
today.title: Today
today.doneBody: Come back tomorrow for a new lesson and your review. You can also do more now if you want.
today.noPlacement: Take the placement test first, so the lessons start at the right level.
today.allDone: You have finished every lesson in your track. You can open any lesson again from the Lessons page.
today.exportReminder: Reminder: browsers can delete site data, especially on iPhone. Save a copy of your progress from time to time.
session.leave: You can leave at any time. Next time you will continue from here.
session.reviewIntro: These are mistakes from earlier days.
ex.fill: Type the missing word or words.
ex.reorder: Tap the words to put them in the correct order.
ex.fix: This sentence has one mistake. Correct it and write the full sentence.
lesson.unreviewed: Not yet reviewed by a teacher.
lessons.title: Lessons
lessons.intro: Your daily lesson follows this order. You can also open any lesson.
mistakes.title: My Mistakes
mistakes.weekly: Mistakes in practice, per week (last 8 weeks)
mistakes.weeklyNote: Placement test answers are not counted in this chart.
mistakes.notEnough: There is not enough data yet to show a trend. Practise for a few more days.
mistakes.none: No mistakes recorded yet. Your mistakes from lessons, review and writing will appear here.
mistakes.chartLabel: Bar chart of mistakes per week
mistakes.placementOnly: Some of these come from the placement test.
mistakes.noExercise: There are no exercises for this type yet.
writing.title: Writing
writing.intro: Choose a task. Write a short answer. Then compare it with the model answer and the self-check list.
writing.tooLong: Your text is longer than the word limit. Try to make it shorter.
writing.honesty: This automatic check finds some common mistakes only. A sentence with no marks may still have mistakes.
writing.nothingMarked: The automatic check did not mark anything. Read your text again with the self-check list.
writing.privacy: Your text is not kept after you finish. Only the mistake types and dates are kept.
settings.title: Settings
settings.retakeNote: Retaking changes where your lessons start. It does not delete your mistakes.
settings.export: Save a copy of my progress (file)
settings.importError.json: This file could not be read.
settings.importError.kind: This is not a progress file from this app.
settings.importError.newer: This file comes from a newer version of the app.
settings.importConfirm: Loading this file will replace your current progress on this device. Continue?
settings.deleteConfirm: This deletes all your progress on this device: your level, lessons, review items and mistakes. It cannot be undone. Are you sure?
settings.neverExported: You have not saved a copy yet.
storage.unavailable: This browser does not allow saving. You can practise, but your progress will be lost when you close the page.
storage.full: The browser storage is full. Your latest progress may not be saved.
storage.recovered: Saved progress could not be read, so the app started fresh. A copy of the old data was kept in the browser.
about.title: About
about.slogan: The only limit is your imagination, without exceeding the limits of Islam.
about.what: A free practice tool for Arabic-speaking adults who are learning English, with a track for engineers.
about.privacy: Nothing leaves your device. There is no account, no tracking and no advertising. The app works offline. Your progress, and any unfinished writing, are kept only in this browser. Exported files do not include unfinished writing.
about.content: All lessons, exercises and writing tasks were written with the help of AI. A person has not yet reviewed them. Levels (A1 to B2) are our own estimate.
about.noSound: The app has no sound and no audio.
about.notCert: This app does not give certificates and is not an official test.
writing.draftNote: While you write, your unfinished text is kept in this browser on this device, so you can come back to it. It is deleted when you finish or skip the task, or delete all progress. It is replaced when you start writing another task. It is never put in an exported file.
error.title: Something went wrong
error.body: The app hit an unexpected problem. Your progress is probably still saved. Try reloading first.
error.reset: Delete all progress and start again
error.resetConfirm: This deletes all your progress on this device: your level, lessons, review items and mistakes. It cannot be undone. Try reloading first. Are you sure?
error.resetFailed: The progress could not be deleted, because this browser does not allow it.
settings.importError.tooLarge: This file is too large to be a progress file from this app, so it was not loaded.
settings.importError.tooMany: This file has more data than a progress file from this app can have, so it was not loaded. Your current progress has not changed.
recall.think: Think of the English phrase, or say it aloud. Then check.
plan.title: Plans
plan.intro: Each plan shows how it works, its goals, and what you do each day.
plan.honestTitle: What this plan can and cannot do
plan.cta: Try a plan: work phrases, 15 minutes a day
plan.doneToday: You have finished today's plan day. Come back tomorrow for the next one.
plan.stopConfirm: Stop the plan? Your phrase cards and mistakes stay. The plan's days, self-ratings and self-checks are removed from this device.
step.selfCheckIntro: Answer honestly. There is no score. You will answer the same questions on the last day.
step.selfCheckEndIntro: These are the same questions as on day 1. You can compare your answers on the "What you did" screen.
step.nothingDue: Nothing is due for review today.
step.learnNote: Read each phrase aloud and think of when you would use it at work. It will come back in review tomorrow.
step.retell: Retell the story from another person's view
step.retellNote: Write it here or say it aloud. Your text is not saved.
step.recallNote: Only phrases that are due today move to the next box. The others are extra practice.
step.sayNote: The app cannot hear you and cannot check your speech. Say your answer aloud, then compare it with the sample.
step.sayRate: How did it go? Rate yourself.
sayRate.1: I needed to read the sample
sayRate.2: I said it with some pauses
sayRate.3: I said it clearly without reading
progress.phrases: Phrases in box 3 or higher: {n} of {total}
progress.selfCheck: Self-check: day 1 and the last day
progress.atEnd: When you finish the plan, this page will show what you can do now and what you cannot do yet.
progress.privacy: This information stays on this device. It is included when you save a copy of your progress. There is no score and no tracking.
progress.noPlan: You have not started a plan.
step.recallAllDone: All of these phrases were already reviewed today. Nothing more to do here.
plan.reviewDayLonger: Review days can take longer than 15 minutes, because they bring back many phrases at once. You can stop at any time and continue later.
settings.importPlanDropped: The plan data in this file was damaged, so it was not loaded. Your other progress was loaded.
